projectDetails.trustClientName: Great Ormond Street Hospital for Children NHS Foundation Trust
projectDetails.projectDescription: New paediatric centre of excellence with advanced surgical theatres, imaging suite, and family accommodation
projectDetails.projectNarrative: Great Ormond Street Hospital is delivering a landmark paediatric centre of excellence that will set new standards for children's healthcare facilities globally. The building combines highly complex clinical spaces including advanced surgical theatres and an MRI suite with child-friendly environments and on-site family accommodation. Lendlease has been appointed to deliver the project using their industry-leading platform-based approach to design for manufacture and assembly, targeting the highest levels of pre-manufactured value achieved on any NHS project. The FBC demonstrates exceptional value for money with a 22-week programme saving and 35% defect reduction compared to traditional construction benchmarks.

items.name: Significant programme reduction
items.description: Platform-based approach with extensive parallel manufacture delivers 22-week programme reduction, with 65% of building components manufactured off-site concurrently with foundations

items.name: Rapid watertight envelope
items.description: Unitised facade system achieves watertight envelope 14 weeks ahead of traditional programme, enabling early commencement of internal fit-out

items.name: Exceptional quality and precision
items.description: Factory-controlled manufacture achieves tolerances of +/- 2mm across all structural and architectural components, with 35% fewer defects at handover

items.name: Enhanced health and safety performance
items.description: 70% reduction in working at height, 60% reduction in manual handling, and elimination of hot works from the building envelope

items.name: Net zero carbon in construction
items.description: Optimised material use, reduced transport, and renewable energy in manufacturing achieves 45% reduction in embodied carbon with residual emissions offset

items.name: Superior whole life value
items.description: Cost certainty through fixed-price manufacturing, reduced defect rectification, and improved thermal performance deliver 15% improvement in whole life cost assessment

items.name: Central London site logistics
items.description: Highly constrained central London site adjacent to operational hospital. Comprehensive logistics management plan with off-site consolidation centre in Stratford and overnight deliveries for large components.

items.name: Complex clinical adjacencies
items.description: Advanced surgical theatres and MRI suite require specialist installation by equipment manufacturers. MMC approach accommodates these through structural shell-and-core strategy with dedicated specialist fit-out zones.

items.name: Has a pre-manufactured value target been set?
items.description: PMV target of 75% established in project brief and endorsed by NHSE as exemplar project

items.name: Has a logistics strategy for MMC delivery been developed?
items.description: Comprehensive logistics plan with off-site consolidation centre, JIT delivery scheduling, and ANPR tracking

items.name: Is there a designated MMC coordination role on the project?
items.description: Dedicated MMC Strategy Lead (Dr. James Bowden) with team of 4 MMC coordinators

items.name: Has a design-for-manufacture review been completed?
items.description: Comprehensive DfMA reviews at each RIBA stage with manufacturing input from Stage 0

items.name: Percentage of building elements with standardised dimensions
items.description: 85% of elements on platform-based standardised dimensions; only specialist clinical spaces deviate

items.name: Has a tolerance management strategy been implemented?
items.description: Rigorous tolerance management with digital verification at factory and on-site using robotic total stations

items.name: Have MMC suppliers been engaged in early design?
items.description: All key MMC suppliers engaged from RIBA Stage 0 through Lendlease's supply chain partnerships

items.name: Is the procurement route compatible with MMC?
items.description: Bespoke partnering arrangement with integrated project delivery model optimised for MMC

items.name: Percentage of packages with MMC specification included
items.description: 85% of work packages have confirmed MMC specification with signed supplier commitments

items.name: Has the client endorsed an MMC-first approach?
items.description: Trust Board, NHSE, and DHSC jointly endorsed as MMC exemplar project

items.name: Are clinical user groups engaged with MMC implications?
items.description: Extensive clinical engagement programme including full-scale mock-up ward visited by 200+ staff and patient families

items.name: Do proposed manufacturers hold relevant quality certifications?
items.description: All manufacturers hold ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and relevant BOPAS/BBA certifications

items.name: Has factory capacity been confirmed for project timescales?
items.description: Manufacturing slots confirmed with all suppliers; dedicated production lines at Lendlease's Wolverhampton facility

items.name: Is there a factory inspection and quality audit programme?
items.description: Monthly factory audits with real-time quality dashboards and automated defect tracking
